title: TejasAI Prompt Enhancement Test Set
purpose: Regression testing for prompt enhancement. The expected behavior is to improve wording while preserving the user's intent; do not answer the prompt.
usage_notes: Inputs intentionally include everyday typing, spelling, grammar, punctuation, Hinglish, and mixed Hindi-English.
Expected outputs are illustrative targets, not the only acceptable enhancements.
For short factual questions, preserve the question and do not supply the answer.
For vague prompts that depend on missing context, preserve the reference or ask a minimal clarification only when necessary.
